typed_boundaries.snapshot: Typed set_dashes(Array[Double]) copies its input, explicitly mapping to the actual immutable Python tuple profile. It does not promise native mutable list reference behavior.
typed_boundaries.containers: Eight native list alias/history and two None-pair observations remain complete source-only. Native physical tuple/list/int types and identity flags remain evidence rather than a general dynamic container contract.
typed_boundaries.history: The caller Array is mutated after its first call; repeated native use of the old immutable tuple is projected with the original tuple values, never the changed caller Array. Existing Style/retained snapshots are compared logically by exact numeric values.
typed_boundaries.draw: All fourteen draw cases execute the real checked backend. Successful paints compare order/count/RGBA meaning and parsed dash values; completed native RGBA stages get bit checks only after actual draw, never early foreground resolution. Private backend tests cover writer prefixes on failures.
typed_boundaries.setup: Private mark_drawn is controlled native clean-stale input. Manual frame/Null ticks and one initial null-dataLim/request seed isolate the original leaf that omitted add_line/update_line_limits; no later state is normalized.
typed_boundaries.float: Finite values, signed zero and infinities compare by bits; NaN by classification, without a native payload contract.
typed_boundaries.scope: Original method/body/hash/host/stage observations are preserved. No markers, caps/joins, arbitrary callbacks, dynamic NumPy containers, native CSS text or pixel overlap promise is introduced.
